Subject: New claim - Aisha Whitfield

Dear Claims Team,

I am writing to report a loss at 88 High Street, Oxford. On 11/09/2024 the garage was broken into and power tools and a lawnmower were stolen. I could not find my policy documents but I have been insured with you for years. I would like to claim USD 2,200.00 to cover the damage. Your reference for this is CLM-27995.

Kind regards,
Aisha Whitfield

Subject: Another claim - Samuel Kowalski

Dear Claims Team,

You may remember my earlier claim CLM-68100: on August 2, 2024 the garage was broken into and power tools and a lawnmower were stolen, and you paid $11,150. That one is closed.

Unfortunately I need to report a new loss. On 21/10/2024 the insured vehicle collided with a van that pulled out of a side road at 41 Orchard Close, Norwich. My policy number is POL-41994 and I am claiming $9,800.00. Please open a new reference, CLM-11728.

Thanks,
Samuel Kowalski

Subject: New claim - Tariq Nakamura

Dear Claims Team,

I am writing to report a loss at 30 Elm Grove, Brighton. My policy number is POL-54580. On 28 June 2024 a customer tripped over a loose floor mat in the shop and injured a knee. Please note I previously held policy POL-86008 with another household, which was cancelled in 2021. I would like to claim $12,100.00 to cover the damage. Your reference for this is CLM-92133.

Kind regards,
Tariq Nakamura

Subject: Claim for Owen Rahman

Hello,

Policy POL-31805, reference CLM-59875. On 24/07/2024 a failed washing machine hose leaked for several hours and ruined the kitchen flooring at Unit 12, Riverside Estate, Derby.

The contractor quoted USD 108,200.00 for a full renovation of the area, but that includes upgrades I am paying for myself. I am only claiming $12,850, which is the cost of putting it back as it was.

Regards,
Owen Rahman
